description: 披露 E-PRTR 附件 II 所列污染物排入水体的量。
display_definition: Mass of each pollutant discharged to water (COD, ammonia nitrogen, total N/P, heavy metals such as Cu/Zn/Pb); map every pollutant row. Not wastewater volume, not concentration, not intensity.
display_label: 向水体排放污染物 Pollutants emitted to water
exclusions: 标题、目录、空白、未披露状态不能作为带值事实；显式零与缺失分开。
不能以空气污染物排放量、耗水量、取水量、排水体积、污染物浓度替代本条款所定义的测量或说明。
